conventions: One entry per code and side. Side A is the front, side B the back of a double-sided card; a shadow effect is a line of side A.
lines are the ability text of the text box in print order, one ability per line: no title, traits, stats, flavor text, or Victory line. Keyword lines (Surge., Doomed 1., Loot., Discover 4.) stay.
Icons are written as the words Hall of Beorn uses (Willpower, Attack, Defense, Threat, Lore, Fellowship). Apostrophes and quotation marks are straight.
A printed typo is written corrected in lines, and the printed wording is kept under misprints.
inert lists line numbers that need no effect record, with the reason. A line that is only keywords the engine reads is owned by the keyword.
A quest stage's card side B is its stage B; Gollum / Sméagol is one physical card whose two sides are two catalog cards (Gollum, Sméagol), each side A of its own code.

A campaign card's side A opens with the marker line "You are playing campaign mode."; its side B holds the Resolution paragraphs, each paragraph one line. The Campaign Log's divider between a Forced line and the Resolution is not a line.
A card whose 2023 wording differs from the 2015 Treason of Saruman or Land of Shadow printing it reprints is listed in MEC112_CHANGED (scripts/data/printed/scope.ts).
